description_en: Triggers an Agent on Mobile nodes to execute an AI automation task
description_zh: 触发 Mobile 节点上 Agent 执行 AI 自动化任务
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic run-agent-task --instance-ids acp-5hh4a31emkt6u0000 --user-prompt '去应用宝下载钉钉' --max-steps 30 --timeout-seconds 3600 --biz-region-id cn-shanghai --task-config-id tsk-260625-49be0000 --schedule-id sch-260625-pbj20000 --run-config '{"Skills":["sk-abc","sk-def"]}' --targets InstanceId=acp-5hh4a31emkt6u0000 SessionId=ses-260702-21bh0000。 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunAgentTask

parameters.help_en: The list of Mobile node IDs. A maximum of 100 nodes are supported per request
parameters.help_zh: Mobile节点ID列表。一次请求最多支持100个节点
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The user instruction in natural language. The Agent performs operations based on this instruction
parameters.help_zh: 用户指令（自然语言），Agent 据此完成操作
parameters.name: user_prompt

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of execution steps for the task. This prevents infinite loops. Valid values: 30 to 1000. Default value: 1000
parameters.help_zh: Task最大执行步骤数，防止无限循环。范围 30~1000，默认1000
parameters.name: max_steps

parameters.help_en: The task timeout period, in seconds. Valid values: 300 to 3600. Default value: 3600
parameters.help_zh: 任务超时时间（秒）。范围 300~3600，默认3600
parameters.name: timeout_seconds

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Mobile node
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en: The task configuration ID. This parameter is used to trigger a task with the specified configuration
parameters.help_zh: 任务配置ID，用于触发指定配置的任务
parameters.name: task_config_id

parameters.help_en: The scheduling plan ID. When specified, the execution record is associated with the corresponding scheduled node, which facilitates aggregate query by scheduling dimension through aggregation
parameters.help_zh: 调度计划ID，传入时执行记录关联到对应的定时任务，便于按调度维度聚合查询
parameters.name: schedule_id

fields.help_en: The list of skill IDs. A maximum of 10 skill IDs are supported. Only the first skill is passed through during command delivery. All skills are stored in task_skill_relation for reverse lookup
fields.help_zh: 技能ID列表，最多10个；命令下发仅透传第一个，task_skill_relation 落库全部用于反查
fields.name: skills

parameters.help_en: The runtime configuration that carries the runtime parameters (skills) for this task
parameters.help_zh: 运行配置，承载本次任务的运行期参数（技能）
parameters.name: run_config

fields.help_en: The Mobile node ID, such as acp-xxx
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The session ID. Tasks with the same session ID share context, such as ses-260702-21b****
fields.help_zh: 会话ID，同sessionid的任务共享上下文，如ses-260702-21b****
fields.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: An array of target objects. Each element contains an InstanceId and a SessionId
parameters.help_zh: Targets 是一个数组，每个元素是包含 InstanceId 和 SessionId 的对象
parameters.name: targets

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to write the task artifacts to the user's OSS bucket
parameters.help_zh: 是否将该任务产物写入用户 OSS
parameters.name: save_artifacts

Code.description_en: The status code of the operation

CurrentStatus.description_en:
The current status of the task. Valid values:

PENDING: The task is being created.

RUNNING: The task is running.

COMPLETED: The task is completed.

FAILED: The task failed.

TIMEOUT: The task timed out.

CALL_FOR_USER: Waiting for user action.

PAUSING: The task is being paused.

PAUSED: The task is paused.

CANCELLING: The task is being canceled.

CANCELED: The task is canceled.

STOPPED: The task is stopped.

TIMEOUT: The task timed out
CurrentStatus.description_zh:
任务当前状态，参考下方状态枚举，取值如下：

PENDING 任务创建中。

RUNNING 任务运行中。

COMPLETED 任务已完成。

FAILED 任务失败。

TIMEOUT 任务执行超时。

CALL_FOR_USER 等待用户操作。

PAUSING 暂停中。

PAUSED 已暂停。

CANCELLING 取消中。

CANCELED 已取消。

STOPPED 已停止。

TIMEOUT 超时

RunningAt.description_en: The time when the task was created, in ISO 8601 format
RunningAt.description_zh: 任务创建时间，ISO 8601 格式

SessionId.description_en: The session ID. Tasks with the same session ID share context
SessionId.description_zh: 会话ID，同sessionid的任务共享上下文

TaskId.description_en: The task ID, which is globally unique

UserPrompt.description_en: The user instruction in natural language. The Agent performs operations based on this instruction
UserPrompt.description_zh: 用户指令（自然语言），Agent 据此完成操作
